visual.title: One bound, one price
visual.caption: Raising x + 2y ≤ 4 by 0.2 moves the optimum along the other active line. The value rises by 1/3 of 0.2, about 0.067, until the basis changes.

predict.question: Raise the bound x + 2y ≤ 4 by 0.2. About how much does the optimum value rise?
predict.explain: The shadow price of x + 2y is 1/3, so a 0.2 increase adds about 0.067. The price stays valid while both resource constraints remain active, from a bound of 2.5 to 10.

label: Estimate a change
subgoals: multiply the price by the change
